entries.comment: The 10% rate only applies to the amateur sporting events.

Usually exempted if supplied by a public body or non-profit making organization. The reduced rate is regulated in chapter 9 section 18 in the Swedish VAT Act (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/mervardesskattelag-2023200_sfs-2023-200#K9).
